title: Pharmacy or Clinic
setting: Pharmacy counter or basic clinic visit
userGoal: Describe symptoms, ask for help, and understand simple instructions.
starterPrompts: Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer.
culturalNotes: Healthcare language should stay simple, clear, and direct.
It helps to say when the symptom started and where it hurts.
Learners should practice listening for dosage and timing instructions.
likelyMisunderstandings: The learner may describe the symptom but forget when it started.
The pharmacist may give dosage instructions quickly or bundle them together.
The learner may confuse a clinic appointment with a pharmacy question.

variants.title: Pharmacy counter
variants.setup: You are asking for medicine at a busy pharmacy.
variants.localReplyStyle: The pharmacist asks a short symptom question and then gives dosage details.
variants.pressureNote: Listen for the medicine name, how often to take it, and whether food matters.
variants.starterPrompt: Tengo dolor de garganta y un poco de fiebre.

variants.title: Clinic reception
variants.setup: You are calling or speaking to the front desk at a small clinic.
variants.localReplyStyle: The receptionist asks for name, reason, and the next available appointment.
variants.pressureNote: The answer may include a date and a time in one sentence.
variants.starterPrompt: Necesito una cita para esta semana.

variants.title: Night symptoms
variants.setup: You are explaining a symptom that started last night.
variants.localReplyStyle: The helper may ask whether it is urgent or if you already took medicine.
variants.pressureNote: Use simple timing words like ayer, hoy, and desde anoche.
variants.starterPrompt: Desde anoche tengo dolor y fiebre.

turns.title: Describe the symptom
turns.learnerGoal: Say the symptom and when it started.
turns.prompt: Buenos dias. Que le duele y desde cuando?
turns.repairCue: If the learner only names the symptom, ask when it started.

branchOptions.label: Headache
branchOptions.prompt: Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer.

turns.title: Understand the instruction
turns.learnerGoal: Listen for the medicine and the dose.
turns.prompt: Le recomiendo esta medicina. Tome una cada ocho horas con comida.
turns.repairCue: If the learner misses the schedule, repeat only the timing phrase.

branchOptions.label: Confirm the dose
branchOptions.prompt: Una cada ocho horas con comida, verdad?

turns.title: Close safely
turns.learnerGoal: Confirm the next step and thank the helper.
turns.prompt: Si empeora, vuelva manana o busque una cita.
turns.repairCue: If the learner only says thanks, ask them to repeat the next step.

branchOptions.label: Thank and confirm
branchOptions.prompt: Gracias. Entonces tomo una cada ocho horas.

branchOptions.label: Ask about appointment
branchOptions.prompt: Y si necesito cita, donde la pido?

followUpDrills.title: State the symptom clearly
followUpDrills.goal: Practice symptom plus timing in one short sentence.
followUpDrills.prompt: Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer.

followUpDrills.title: Compare two instruction styles
followUpDrills.goal: Practice repeating a medical instruction in two different ways.
followUpDrills.prompt: Tome una cada ocho horas con comida. / Tome una tres veces al dia con comida.

followUpDrills.title: Shadow the dose line
followUpDrills.goal: Copy the medicine instruction at natural speed.
followUpDrills.prompt: Tome una cada ocho horas con comida.

followUpDrills.title: Dictate the medicine line
followUpDrills.goal: Write the dosage and timing you hear.
followUpDrills.prompt: Tome una cada ocho horas con comida y vuelva si empeora.

followUpDrills.title: Split symptoms and instructions
followUpDrills.goal: Let one partner explain the symptom and the other repeat the instruction.
followUpDrills.prompt: Partner A explains the symptom. Partner B repeats the medicine instruction.

coupleSupport.sharedGoal: One partner explains the problem while the other keeps track of the medicine or appointment details.
partnerRoles: Partner A describes the symptom and timing
Partner B repeats the dose or appointment detail
handoffPrompts: Ahora tu pareja repite la instruccion de la medicina.
Tu turno: confirma la cita o el horario.
coupleSupport.keepBothInvolvedTip: Split the symptom story from the instruction story so both partners have a job.

listeningCues.previewLine: Tome una cada ocho horas con comida y vuelva si empeora.
